items.title: In southern Philippines, Tawi-Tawi builds feasts to be shared
items.description: Food becomes art, memory, and hospitality in Bongao during the Kamahardikaan sin Tawi-Tawi celebrations

items.title: Pete Lacaba for National Artist. My mother would have approved.
items.description: Jose “Pete” Lacaba will be honored  by fellow writers and artists in a tribute on October 10

items.title: ICC allows written testimony vs Duterte
items.description: The International Criminal Court has allowed the prosecution to introduce as evidence a prior testimony of one of its witnesses against former president Rodrigo Duterte.

items.title: Sara wants copy of ex-cop’s affidavit
items.description: Vice President Sara Duterte wants to be provided first with a copy of the sworn affidavit of Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. before being required to face the National Bureau of Investigation to shed light on the allegations of the dismissed police officer that he delivered cash in suitcases to her and to some members of her family.

items.title: Public urged to save water while supply remains steady
items.description: As the country faces what could be a super El Niño, consumers should save water while there is steady supply, National Water Resources Board executive director Sevillo David Jr. said yesterday.

items.title: Trial verdict on December 16? No timetable yet, senators say
items.description: Two senators yesterday denied impeachment court spokesman Reginald Tongol’s statement that they have set a Dec. 16 verdict date on Vice President Sara Duterte’s trial.

items.title: Gibo: Turn over ‘China money’ evidence to authorities
items.description: Defense Secretary Gilbert Teodoro yesterday urged former senator Antonio Trillanes IV to turn over to authorities his evidence relating to his allegations that the Duterte family received about P319 million in funds from China, in order to facilitate a thorough investigation.

items.title: Staggered LPG price hike set
items.description: Republic Gas Corp. has begun implementing a staggered P18-per-kilogram price increase for its liquefied petroleum gas products, rendering the excise tax suspension futile as global crude prices remain elevated.

items.title: BOC hits record P757.4 billion collection
items.description: The Bureau of Customs collected P757.406 billion for the first nine months of 2026.

items.title: VP on Trillanes claims: Same exhausted lies
items.description: Former senator Antonio Trillanes IV “has been peddling exhausted lies since 2016,” Vice President Sara Duterte asserted yesterday.

items.title: Most Pinoys feel free to criticize government – SWS
items.description: Almost six in 10 Filipinos feel free to openly speak even against the government, a survey conducted by Social Weather Stations showed.

items.title: These former inmates turn life behind bars into art
items.description: For the formerly incarcerated members of the Bagongbuhay Group of Artists, art becomes one way of confronting the difficulty of rebuilding life after release

items.title: Sara Duterte camp hits Trillanes over ‘desperate, tired narratives’
items.description: Vice President Sara Duterte's spokesperson Salvador Paolo Panelo Jr. on Saturday, October 3, hit former senator Antonio Trillanes IV over allegations linking the vice president's family to Chinese funds, calling them “desperate and tired narratives.”

items.title: Converge package offers 0% commission fees for 3 months on TikTok Shop
items.description: Converge ICT Solutions, DTI, and TikTok Shop launch SellerPlus, offering new online sellers a three-month commission-free period and essential tools to boost their e-commerce ventures

items.title: Subsea cable cut between Philippines and Singapore disrupts internet services
items.description: Internet users in the Philippines face intermittent connections after undersea cable cut forces telecoms to reroute traffic to restore services

items.title: Jiu-jitsu’s Alex Enriquez falls short of PH’s 5th gold in Asian Games
items.description: Alexandria Enriquez's narrow defeat in the women's 63kg final comes a day after boxer Carlo Paalam and taekwondo jins Tachiana Mangin and Kurt Barbosa also missed out on gold medals

items.title: Computer science has long understood what it takes to keep AI under control
items.description: Recent AI hacking incidents revive a long-standing computer science problem: what happens when machines pursue a goal without enough limits.

items.title: How Filipino director BC Amparado tackled Japan’s ‘lonely death’ phenomenon
items.description: The film ‘Mono No Aware’ marks director BC Amparado’s full-fledged pivot to independent filmmaking, leaving behind his corporate job and the financial stability it used to offer

items.title: At Cornell, rape allegations spark outrage, soul-searching over campus culture
items.description: 'Cornell has failed our community through its lack of accountability, transparency, and failure to address the state of the Cornell student body at this time,' says a student from the university
